summary: Okta group-sync delay removes runner roleBindings for release service-account during nightly rollout
description:
Issue summary: During the scheduled nightly Okta group membership sync (critical path for IAM grants) a delay between the IdP and our group-sync agent caused cached group membership to expire. The ephemeral release service-account (release-sa@redwood) lost Kubernetes RoleBindings that grant it permission to register and annotate ephemeral CI runners. Impact: several nightly release jobs failed to provision runners and ongoing canary rollouts stalled. User-facing impact limited to internal release cadence (no customer-facing downtime), but this blocked automated canary promotion and caused a manual release delay of ~90 minutes.

Observed: At 02:15 UTC the group-sync agent logged repeated 5xx responses from the Okta API and subsequently dropped group membership for the release-sa. The k8s-operator reconciler attempted to register runners but was rejected with "forbidden: user not bound to role" errors. The Okta primary certificate was rotated earlier in the night by IdP team; agent retried but backoff and local TTLs expired before membership was refreshed.
steps_to_reproduce: Trigger an Okta certificate rotation in staging with a simulated short-lived API outage (10-15m)
Have group-sync agent use default backoff and local cache TTL (as configured in prod)
Run a nightly release pipeline that provisions ephemeral runners tied to release-sa
Observe k8s-operator runner registration failing with RoleBinding missing errors
investigation_notes: 02:10 UTC - Release automation began provisioning 12 runners for canary. Initial requests succeeded.
02:12 UTC - Okta rotated cert; IdP responses intermittently returned 502/504 for ~12m. Group-sync logged 502s and incremented local miss counters.
02:18 UTC - Local cache TTL for group membership (configured 10m) expired; group-sync returned empty membership for release-sa and updated k8s RBAC records removing rolebindings.
02:21 UTC - k8s-operator attempted to create runner pods; API returned 403 'user not bound to role' from admission webhook. Pod creation failed and pipeline stalled.
02:30 UTC - Manually re-applied RoleBinding as emergency workaround to restore release-sa permissions; first pipelines resumed provisioning at ~02:45 UTC.

Hypothesis: brittle cache TTL + aggressive cache invalidation policy combined with Okta transient errors. Agent should be resilient to temporary IdP flakiness and avoid removing rolebindings until a confirmed membership change is observed across retries.
Logs: included snippets from group-sync agent, k8s-operator admission webhook, and runner-service error traces (archived to S3: s3://redwood-support/INT-863274/logs/)
Cross-reference: IdP rotation event logged by security-idp channel #idp-rotations-2026-03-10 at 02:11 UTC
workaround: Manually re-applied RoleBinding for release-sa and disabled automatic rolebinding prune in group-sync agent config (set prune=false) to allow pipelines to finish. This is a temporary safe-open setting until we deploy a fix. Manual rollout required for two affected clusters in us-east-1.
resolution: Partial mitigation applied 2026-03-10 02:30 UTC (manual RoleBinding re-apply + temporary prune disable). Engineering patch PR created to modify group-sync behavior: (1) increase membership confirmation window to 5 consecutive negative checks over 30m before pruning, (2) add exponential backoff and circuit breaker on IdP 5xx errors, (3) add automated retry that preserves current rolebindings during transient IdP failures. Patch PR: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/452. Planned rollout to prod 2026-03-13 04:00 UTC after smoke tests in staging. Postmortem owners: Marcus Nguyen (lead), Priya Shah (idp). Follow-ups: update runbook to include immediate step to re-apply RoleBinding and a new alert when group-sync experiences >5m continuous 5xx from IdP.
comments: Ava Patel (Reporter) - 2026-03-10 03:05: 'Filed ticket after manual unblock. We should treat any IdP 5xx window as tolerated for rolebindings; removing privileges is too aggressive.'

Marcus Nguyen (Assignee) - 2026-03-10 04:12: 'Confirmed logs. Re-applied RoleBinding and set prune=false. I'll open patch PR to change confirmation window and backoff. Need IdP team to share rotation schedule.'
